faq.a: Tumaini is associated with the Arabic form طُمَأْنِينَة, whose core sense is tumaini; calm, reassurance (swahili form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Tumaini?
faq.a: Tumaini is associated with Arabic. Tumaini is the Swahili form of Arabic طُمَأْنِينَة (Ṭumaʾnīna), meaning 'calm, reassurance'.
Yes — the underlying form طُمَأْنِينَة is Arabic.
Tumaini can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Tumaini should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ṭumaʾnīna is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Tumaini mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Tumaini is rendered طمأنینہ and carries the sense طمأنینہ، سکون.

faq.q: What does Tumaini mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Tumaini is rendered طمأنینه and carries the sense طمأنینه، آرامش.
A romanized syllable approximation is tu-mai-ni. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Tumaini?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Tumaini, tumaini. Script forms are طمأنينه, طمأنینه, طمأنینہ, طُمَأْنِينَة, तुमैनी.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
